_note: Round 75: the Atlas (scripts/systems/Atlas.gd) remembers where you've been; the Map page (scripts/MapScreen.gd) draws it. tile_px: pixels a map cell takes at zoom 1. max_levels: how many places the atlas remembers (the oldest are forgotten first). refresh_s: how often it looks for landmarks you've come across. sight_cells: how near you must be to notice a landmark where there is no fog. floors_total: the floors drawn in the world view's column.
